text:
maria: Heads-up — saw a handful of backup uploads to s3 that lack SSE headers in staging. took a quick peek at object metadata and cmk id is missing. could be related to the RBAC sweep we ran last night. tagging for triage.

sam: ugh. do we have a CloudTrail/Storage audit query to show which principal uploaded them?

maria: quick metadata snippet:
object: s3://redwood-backups/staging/db-2026-03-22.tar.gz
metadata: { "x-amz-server-side-encryption": null, "x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id": null }
no CMK header.

raj: ran a CloudTrail filter for PutObject around 2026-03-22T03:12Z — three events show principal `serviceAccount:backup-uploader@infra` and userAgent `backup-agent/2.1`. pasted raw here:
```
PutObject event: time=2026-03-22T03:12:09Z owner=backup-uploader@infra x-amz-sse=null
PutObject event: time=2026-03-22T03:12:11Z owner=backup-uploader@infra x-amz-sse=null
PutObject event: time=2026-03-22T03:12:14Z owner=backup-uploader@infra x-amz-sse=null
```

emma: ok two possible causes: uploader lost ability to fetch CMK grant (RBAC change), or uploader process switched to fallback path that doesn't set SSE header (config). we should verify KMS grants for `backup-uploader` and check the uploader config diff.

sam: i can flip on a quick audit query: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.insert" AND resource.labels.bucket_name="redwood-backups"' --freshness=2d` and correlate with service account. also check iam policy change log: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.type="project"' --limit=50`.

maria: can someone run `aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123:role/backup-uploader`? want to confirm grants exist at that time. if grants missing -> likely RBAC prune.

raj: ran `list-grants` against CMK: 2 grants returned but neither references backup-uploader role. last grant update 2026-03-22T02:58Z. suspicious.

maria: thanks. that's aligned with the RBAC sweep that rolled earlier at 02:45Z (deploy-bot posted a rollout). @deploy-bot can you paste the rollout id?

deploy-bot: rollout: infra/rbac-sweep-2026-03-22 deployed at 2026-03-22T02:46:01Z by ops-auto. PR: https://git.internal/infra/rbac-sweep-2026-03-22

sam: ok, mitigation options: 1) emergency add temporary grant for backup-uploader to CMK (quick), 2) apply bucket policy to require `sse=aws:kms` for PutObject, 3) patch uploader to fail-open vs fail-safe (we prefer fail-safe). i can push 1 and 2 now.

emma: favor 2 as enforcement (prevents future omissions) and 1 as immediate stopgap so existing backups are re-encrypted on next run. but need to think about restores: missing SSE means existing objects are effectively unencrypted-at-rest with respect to our CMK guarantees — risk assessment needed (who can read these objects?).

maria: risk note: staging only for these artifacts, not prod. still escalate because process could be same in prod. assign: raj do root cause (why grants removed), sam do emergency grant + bucket policy, emma do restore-read-scope assessment. i'll open an incident ticket.

oncall: acknowledged. will monitor for any similar anomalies in prod pipeline. please post incident ID when created.

raj: quick find — RBAC sweep PR removed a wildcard grant on CMK inadvertently (diff shows `kms:Use` principal list changed). opening a revert/patch PR now.

sam: temporary grant created for backup-uploader and bucket policy applied to staging bucket (applied as deny to PutObject without `x-amz-server-side-encryption`). patch PR: https://git.internal/infra/patchs/patch-1234. rolling to staging.

maria: great. emma, do you have read-scope?

emma: read-scope: objects are in staging bucket with restricted ACLs; only infra and eng accounts had access. i don't see external access logs. risk low but we'll mark as P2. adding a note to incident ticket.

maria: next steps: 1) raj finish RCA and revert RBAC change in kms grant list, 2) sam verify uploader release includes assert on SSE header and add unit test, 3) emma update restore runbook to include detection for SSE header absence, 4) oncall add monitoring alarm for PutObject events without SSE header.

sam: will also add an automated check in the CI for RBAC sweeps: any change to kms grant lists must have sign-off from sec-eng.

maria: thanks everyone. incident ticket: INC-2026-0423 created — link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0423. tagging this thread for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

oncall: noted. monitoring rule in place and will alert on similar events.

raj: PRs opened: revert-rbac-cmk-grant (#567), uploader-assert-sse (#568). i'll follow up with timeline in the ticket.

maria: closing slack triage. follow-up in the incident thread. :thumbsup:
